Chapter 1044: 6 Are You The Great Lord? (Seeking Monthly Pass)_2

Chapter 1044: Chapter 6 Are You the Great Lord? (Seeking Monthly Pass)_2

As for whether killing Lin Yuan would incite Lord Qingfen’s wrath?

The Purple Dream Domain and Qingfen Domain are inherently adversaries. Even if Lin Yuan were spared, would Lord Qingfen possibly let them go? “Then let’s give it a try.”

The purple-haired woman considered for a fleeting moment and quickly made her decision.

She was also curious to see what qualities a disciple nurtured so meticulously by Lord Qingfen would possess. …

Since the decision was made to act.

The purple-haired woman and her companions wasted no time, appearing instantly in front of the Sky Burning Court. “This Sky Burning Court is one of Lord Qingfen’s retreat spots and a residence for the favored disciple; it’s surely protected by a formidable array. We must act swiftly, and if we find that we can’t breach the array, depart immediately.”

The purple-haired woman clearly understood the group’s objective: replicate all the arrays within the city.

As for killing Lord Qingfen’s treasured disciple? That was purely incidental; success would be ideal, but failure shouldn’t interfere with their main task. “Understood.”

The other powerful figures nodded in agreement, sharing her perspective. A mere attempt posed no risk or downside. …

Inside the Sky Burning Court.

Lin Yuan gazed out beyond.

In fact, the moment the purple-haired woman’s group employed the Myriad Formation Crystal to replicate the arrays surrounding the Sky Burning Court,

Lin Yuan had already detected their presence.

However, adhering to Lord Qingfen’s instructions, he had refrained from taking action, continuing his cultivation undisturbed.

But now, the group had arrived right outside the Sky Burning Court. “What are they trying to do?”

Lin Yuan stepped out of the pavilion, still within the protective range of the great array. … “So this is Lord Qingfen’s newly accepted disciple?”

The purple-haired woman spotted Lin Yuan, but without a word, she struck directly.

In an instant.

A hazy purple force began to envelop the Sky Burning Court, while other Purple Dream Domain powerhouses unleashed their methods, holding nothing back, aiming to kill Lin Yuan in the shortest possible time.

The intelligence regarding Lin Yuan obtained by the purple-haired woman and her companions came from the Yu Family. Before apprenticing under Lord Qingfen, Lin Yuan had only reached the Eighth Layer of cultivation.

With their Half-step Great Honor tier of strength, even with the great array’s protection, as long as even a trace of power seeped through,

Lin Yuan would have no chance of survival.

Rumble.

Terrifying energy crashed toward the Sky Burning Court.

At that moment, an invisible barrier rose around the Sky Burning Court.

The combined attacks of more than ten Half-step Great Honors were completely intercepted by the barrier,

Their strikes dissipated soundlessly, vanishing in an instant. “A defensive formation of this caliber?”

The purple-haired woman’s expression grew grave, and she immediately abandoned further efforts to strike.

She could tell that the defenses of the Sky Burning Court’s great formation were immensely formidable.

Forget about their Half-step Great Honor strength— even a true Great Honor-level expert wouldn’t be able to breach it in a short amount of time. “Lord Qingfen truly dotes on this disciple…”

The other Purple Dream Domain experts couldn’t help but marvel. The Sky Burning Court wasn’t even the central node of the array, yet its level of defense likely surpassed the core itself.

Was it simply because Lin Yuan resided within? Could it be that Lord Qingfen had specifically adjusted the formation’s coverage for this reason? “Let’s go.” “Don’t waste time here.”

The purple-haired woman promptly decided to leave.

The other Purple Dream Domain powerhouses followed suit. “Their strength isn’t much after all, huh?”

From within the Sky Burning Court, Lin Yuan observed for a while. Watching the power unleashed in the attacks by the purple-haired woman and the others, which had entirely been blocked by the array, he calculated their strength.

With this assessment, Lin Yuan’s thoughts stirred.

A projection of his Primordial Spirit emerged from his body, moving autonomously out of the Sky Burning Court’s confines, stepping beyond the array’s protected zone.

Since moving into the Sky Burning Court, Lin Yuan had been greatly satisfied with the cultivation environment. He had silently watched the havoc the purple-haired woman wrought in Qingfen City.

If he wasn’t sure of her level of strength, Lin Yuan would naturally be cautious— adhering strictly to Lord Qingfen’s advice, staying hidden in the Sky Burning Court.

But now?

The strength of the purple-haired woman and her companions? Nothing to fuss over.

Lin Yuan immediately thought of resolving the threat they posed to Lord Qingfen.

Of course, to exercise caution, Lin Yuan didn’t step out in person. Instead, he sent out a projection of his Primordial Spirit.

This way, even if an extreme scenario occurred—such as the purple-haired woman concealing her true strength, or a hidden Great Honor peak or Heavenly Venerate-level power lurking in the vicinity unnoticed by Lin Yuan— the worst-case scenario would merely cost him a projection, which he could reconstruct at any time. …. “Hmm?”

The purple-haired woman and her companions were just about to leave when they suddenly noticed a figure voluntarily emerging from the Sky Burning Court. “Yu Yan?”

The purple-haired woman stopped in her tracks, staring at Lin Yuan with a mixture of astonishment.

Why wasn’t he staying safely hidden in the Sky Burning Court yet chose to step out voluntarily? “You’re from the Purple Dream Domain?” Lin Yuan looked at the purple-haired woman and her team. “Sneaking around here—there’s no way this is something good.” “Attack him directly.”

The slender man’s figure vanished, blending into the space around him.

Lin Yuan’s voluntary emergence from the Sky Burning Court had presented him with what he deemed an excellent opportunity.

Though he suspect that Yu Yan’s willingness to step out might imply a hidden trump card, did he himself not possess cards as well? “Hmph.”

A Purple Dream Domain expert let out a cold snort. A silent wave of spiritual energy appeared, enveloping Lin Yuan imperceptibly.

Not only the slender man spotted an opening, but almost instantly, the rest of the Purple Dream Domain powerhouses acted, intent on giving Lin Yuan no chance to react. “Hmm?”

The Purple Dream Domain expert who had delivered the soul attack furrowed his brow.

Soul attacks are immediate and undetectable, so his was the first to land on Lin Yuan.

Yet, the assault yielded no feedback whatsoever, as if it had been swallowed by a swamp, disappearing entirely.
